homograph.note: The unit of time reads as unrelated to the ordinal for a learner, and the collocation "second to none" means the opposite of ranking second. There is also a verb /sɪˈkɒnd/, stressed on the second syllable, meaning to transfer an employee temporarily; it is not given a sense here.

senses.definition: better than everything else of its kind, in the phrase "second to none"

examples.en: As a cook, my grandmother was second to none in our family.
examples.fa: مادربزرگم در آشپزی در خانوادهٔ ما بی‌همتا بود.

senses.definition: coming after the first one in order or in a series

examples.en: She finished second in the race and looked very pleased.
examples.fa: او در مسابقه دوم شد و بسیار خشنود به نظر می‌رسید.

senses.definition: one of the sixty parts that a minute is divided into; a very short moment of time

examples.en: Wait a second while I find the key in my bag.
examples.fa: یک ثانیه صبر کن تا کلید را در کیفم پیدا کنم.
